about: Buried Stars is a mystery adventure game from Studio LARGO—the creators of the beloved Korean titles Panic Room and City of Mist—in collaboration with LINE Games.

A mystery adventure set at the collapse site of a live survival audition show. Trapped contestants communicate with each other—and the outside world through social media—as they wait for rescue. But as unexpected events unfold, trust begins to crack, and survival becomes far more complicated.
◆ Murder at a Survival Audition Gone Wrong
During a live broadcast of a survival audition show, the studio building suddenly collapses.
Trapped beneath the rubble, the remaining contestants and crew face something even more terrifying: a murder among them. Who is the culprit? Why did this happen? And how?
◆ Striking Visual Presentation with 3D x 2D Harmony
Dynamic 2D character illustrations are blended into detailed 3D environments
to create an atmospheric and cinematic visual experience.
◆ Immersive Gameplay through Social Media Mechanics
Keep track of real-time public reactions via the in-game “Social Media” and “Timeline.”
These systems not only deepen the immersion but also provide crucial hints to help uncover the truth.
